coverage_gaps.description: This cell's outlets cover BANKING earnings well but payments-specific Hungarian trade coverage (card schemes, acquirers, POS, instant payment/AFR, PSD2/e-money issuers) was not surfaced. No dedicated Hungarian payments trade title was identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up pass on Hungarian payments terms — 'azonnali fizetési rendszer', 'AFR', 'bankkártya elfogadás', 'POS terminál', 'fizetési szolgáltató', 'qvik' — across these same outlets and look for niche titles (e.g. IT/fintech blogs, Bankszövetség and MNB payments reports).

coverage_gaps.description: The cell rationale relies on the press as a timestamp/archive layer for unstable filing URLs, but nothing was established about how long these outlets keep articles addressable, whether they have public archives or sitemaps, or whether they are captured by web archives.

brief: Hungarian financial trade press functions as a genuine aggregation and timestamping layer over bank disclosures rather than mere commentary: Portfolio.hu (bank, befektetés and elemzés desks, plus its recurring bank/insurer league table keyed to the 31 May annual-accounts deadline) is the anchor, with Világgazdaság, hvg.hu, Economx, Napi.hu and Index providing same-day corroboration and, crucially, coverage of unlisted and foreign-owned subsidiaries that publish nothing in English. A second tier of comparison/analytics shops (Bankmonitor, Bank360) and the Magyar Bankszövetség press feed sits upstream of much of this reporting and is worth tracking as an early-signal layer, while Forbes.hu's Bank Power Ranking supplies a rare structured read on digital and payments maturity that no regulator publishes. English coverage is thin — Budapest Business Journal is the practical bridge — and no press-maintained earnings calendar was found, so date discovery must lean on 'konszenzus' preview articles or on primary exchange calendars outside this cell. All URLs here are search-derived or path-inferred and are offered unverified for the deterministic liveness pass; paywall depth at Portfolio, hvg and vg.hu remains unmeasured and should be tested before extractors are built.
